newsitem.title: USA: Aavid Thermal names Borelli chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Aavid Thermal names Borelli chairman, CEO.

text.p: Aavid Thermal Technologies Inc said on Wednesday it named Ronald Borelli as chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors, effective October 15.
Borelli will succeed Alan Beane, who has been Aavid's CEO and a principal shareholder since 1985. Beane is leaving to pursue other interests but will continue as a board member, the company said.
Borelli previously served as CEO of Spectra Inc, which was acquired earlier this year by Markem Inc of Keene, New Hampshire.
